boundedCapture.note: Read-only byte/hash custody and XML/source-map parsing. No tests/Java/DB/private env access or product/source-quality review. Delivery artifacts, including resource receipts, hashed opaquely only.

identityFormat: Each path has one bytes/SHA256 identity above; commitBlobOid and filesystemEqualsCommitBlob bind that same identity to the exact commit. Other sections reference paths without repeating seals.

nonoverlap.note: 254 unit cases plus 17 installed integration cases; historical repeated unit passes excluded.

completeSourceComparisons.preciseConclusion: All 379 existing backend Java source hashes are unchanged; final 380-file map adds only Task06WireHttpIT.java. Product source is unchanged; the complete source sets are not identical.

historicalCustodyReference.use: Historical RED/setup-error and duplicate verify counts reused without re-audit. Interim report retained unchanged.

limitations: Mechanical custody only; independent SPEC and quality review is separate.
No re-audit of prior protection inventory, adopted inputs, resource/DB behavior or qualification; those remain root-owned evidence.
Source maps are historical run captures, not an independently instrumented run-end source reseal.
Bounded filesystem reads were stable, but do not assert state after capture.
